messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: crowdfunding for the lavaan project
parts:
Dear lavaan community,

The user base of lavaan is expanding rapidly, and lavaan has become
'critical software' in several research domains.At the same time, the
`bus factor' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bus_factor) for the lavaan
project currently stands at just one, with the primary developer (Yves
Rosseel) facing mounting challenges in allocating sufficient time to
maintain, let alone advance, the lavaan software.

This situation is inherently unsustainable, prompting us to actively
seek solutions for bolstering the lavaan project. In light of this, we
humbly request the lavaan community's consideration of contributing to
the project through a donation. The funds raised will be earmarked
exclusively for the recruitment of highly qualified staff, at the
post-doctoral level, to provide essential support and elevate the
professionalism of the lavaan project. Your generous support will help
ensure the continued growth and vitality of the lavaan software.

More information is provided on the lavaan donation page:

https://lavaan.ugent.be/about/donate.html

If you are already convinced, and you wish to donate right away, click
on the following link:

https://actieplatform.ugent.be/en-GB/p/lavaan-project/step-1

Please spread the word, and distribute this message in your network.

Yves Rosseel.

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: crowdfunding for the lavaan project
parts:
This is a great idea, and a way to show my gratitude for Lavaan (and the whole ecosystem that has risen around Lavaan) in terms of making my life easier, and saving money (and I guess helping to advance my career too - although it's hard to identify the counterfactual to make a strong causal claim).

I've donated, and I'd encourage anyone who uses Lavaan, and who is in a position where they can afford to, to donate too.

Jeremy
